basic_info.description: On a prized street near some of the City's most sought-after private schools, this lovely home is awash in light from its expansive windows.  Ideally-configured for entertaining, the main level has a spacious open floor plan and an expansive kitchen appointed with stainless steel appliances, granite counters and abundant custom cabinetry. The bright living and dining rooms boast soaring ceilings, immaculate hardwood floors and lovely period details.  The spacious primary suite has ample closet space and a beautiful marble-tiled bath with deep soaking tub. A bright guest bedroom has a convenient powder room en suite that has potential to be expanded to a full bath.  A generous deck and lovely garden offer a tranquil retreat from city life.   The remarkably large garage and basement may offer a world of possibilities for expansion.  Expanding the nearby sister home'' at 2203 Broderick Street on the lower level resulted in a 1,995 square feet home per draftsman's floor plan. This lovely home is a rare opportunity for buyers ready to enjoy it as it is and those who want to create their dream home on a coveted block of Pacific Heights.   Very convenient to the shops and restaurants on Union and Fillmore Streets, Alta Plaza and the Presidio!
